global_rain.target: wet reflective pavement, overcast sky, subtle visible falling rain
global_rain.avoid: rain only shown as wet ground without atmosphere

global_snow.target: light snow, realistic winter atmosphere, thin snow on sidewalks and parked cars
global_snow.avoid: heavy snow that hides place-defining facades or road geometry

global_night.target: dim artificial street lighting, reduced saturation, controlled low-light exposure
global_night.avoid: over-dark image or changed facade/window/fence/tree structure

local_person.target: one pedestrian close to the camera, large, naturally integrated, casting a plausible shadow
local_person.avoid: small mid-ground person, pasted sharp person, crowd

local_vehicle.target: one vehicle close to the camera on a plausible road edge or lane, perspective-consistent scale
local_vehicle.avoid: traffic jam, extra parked cars, vehicle that changes road layout

dual_rain_person.target: wet reflective pavement plus one foreground pedestrian with matched rainy lighting
dual_rain_person.avoid: hallucinated vehicles, wrong occluder position, pasted person

dual_night_person.target: dim night lighting plus one pedestrian blended into the same exposure

dual_night_vehicle.target: night lighting plus one vehicle close to camera with realistic headlight spill
dual_night_vehicle.avoid: multiple new cars, traffic jam, changed lane geometry

good_prompts: Task: apply the target weather or time-of-day and add exactly one local occluder. Original intent: Heavy rain at night, wet reflective road surface, preserve lane markings and road structure, realistic atmospheric lighting, high detail Target weather: rain, rain. Occluder: exactly one vehicle, close to the camera, large, significantly obscuring a meaningful local region; one vehicle close to the camera on a plausible road edge or lane, perspective-consistent scale. Precise position: a plausible foreground road edge or lane, perspective-consistent with the scene. Preserve: preserve exact road layout, camera viewpoint, building geometry, lane markings, traffic signs, existing vehicles, and place identity. Forbidden: no new background vehicles, no dense crowds, no traffic jams, no new traffic signs, no readable hallucinated text, no logo or license plate changes, no warped buildings, no changed viewpoint. Style and quality: photorealistic street-view image, natural exposure, matched lighting, realistic shadows, no pasted-object appearance.
